name: clean
description: Smart multi-language clean: target/, dist/, node_modules/, __pycache__/

just.snippet:
# Remove common build/cache directories from the current workspace.
clean:
    -rm -rf target dist build .next .turbo coverage .pytest_cache .ruff_cache .mypy_cache
    -find . -type d -name __pycache__ -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
    -find . -type d -name node_modules -prune -exec rm -rf {} +

task.snippet:
clean:
  desc: Remove common build/cache directories from the current workspace
  cmds:
    - rm -rf target dist build .next .turbo coverage .pytest_cache .ruff_cache .mypy_cache || true
    - find . -type d -name __pycache__ -prune -exec rm -rf {} + || true
    - find . -type d -name node_modules -prune -exec rm -rf {} + || true
